  • Method Details

    • addUser

      public Long addUser(String firstName, String lastName)
      Adds a new user to the network. The id is generated by the repository (by the database, for the database repository).
      Parameters:
      firstName - the first name of the user
      lastName - the last name of the user
      Returns:
      the id given to the new user
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the user is not valid
      RepositoryException - if the user cannot be stored

    • removeUser

      public void removeUser(Long id)
      Removes a user together with all the friendships he or she is part of. The friendships are deleted explicitly, because the file and memory repositories have no cascade.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the user to remove
      Throws:
      EntityNotFoundException - if no user has this id
      RepositoryException - if the data cannot be updated
